description: Clean your own list (CSV text with an email column, optional company, name, website) into leads: drops invalid, duplicate, already-emailed, public-sector, role-mailbox (info@, support@) and no-mail-server addresses, and says why. A list that is mostly unmailable is refused whole. confirmOwnList must be true: it records the caller's statement that these are business contacts they have a reason to write to and that the list was not bought, rented or scraped in bulk.

confirmOwnList.description: True confirms this is your own list of business contacts, not a bought, rented or scraped one.
